caveats: SHSS 4991 OR SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) -- [For students taking one of the Research Options, they should take SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993)]

Students in the Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track with CGA of 3.3 or above may apply for enrollment in the Environment and Technology Research Option. In addition, they should take Honors Thesis or Honors Research with a primary focus in environment and technology to complete the requirement of SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) as specified in the Major Requirements.
SOSC 4290: The course was last offered in 2023-24 and was deleted subsequently.
Environment and Technology Research Option - Elective Course(s): SOSC 4290 is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
